accepted.quote: Safeguarding the integrity of the Child Care and Development Fund (CCDF) is critical but making arbitrary changes to current program reporting requirements under the guise of allegedly fighting fraud while in reality exacerbating the current child care crisis is unacceptable.
accepted.bill: H.R. 7720, the Child Care Payment Integrity and Fraud Accountability Act
accepted.rationale: The passage supports protecting child care funding and opposes reporting changes described as worsening the child care crisis.
